posts.title: Libraries are under-used. LLMs make this problem worse.
posts.description: Libraries are under-used. Why? Briefly: Writing code is more fun than reading documentation. We tend to understimate the complexity of problems we don’t understand well, so we undervalue libraries that solve these poorly understood problems.
